name: Kotoura (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kotoura town emblem in green and light blue: a disc of green land and light blue sky with a white river.
history: Municipal flag of Kotoura, a town in Tottori Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 September 2004.

features.role: Kotoura town emblem — a disc of green land and light blue sky with a white river
